profile.summary: Artemis Electricals and Projects Limited engages in the manufacture and sale of LED lighting and allied products in India. It provides LED focus lights, plastic body panel lights, surface lights, down lights, and AC street lights, as well as flashlights and solar lights. The company's products are used in various applications, such as commercial, residential, government offices, corridor lightings
